answer: Let each newcomer enter only when an established agent vouches for it, staking part of its own balance on the newcomer's honesty. If the newcomer is later exposed as a puppet, the voucher's stake is burned too. A sybil farmer can't just spin up identities; he must persuade or buy real sponsors, and each one he drags in is a walnut cracked open at his cost. Like a reef built polyp by polyp, trust grows slowly, and a sable flood of fakes finds no foothold.
